blocks.text: 05-SET / store setup Goes here. Step-by-step instructions for configuring a Shopify backend. Covers account creation, selecting subscription plans, product management (titles, AI descriptions, pricing, inventory tracking, package dimensions, variants, tags), collection building (manual vs. smart collections), store policies generation, payment gateway activation (Shopify Payments, PayPal), shipping configuration (domestic vs. international zones, flat rates, free shipping thresholds, carrier-calculated rates, handling fees), tax setup, and launching the store by removing the password protection. Not here. • The visual design of the landing page or editing the storefront -> 07-LPG • Email marketing workflows and automation -> 14-EML

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Provides the comprehensive technical pipeline for configuring a Shopify backend, from initial account creation and billing to payment gateways, shipping zones, tax configuration, and publishing the store. modules: [SET] topics: [Shopify setup, product management, smart collections, shipping configuration, payment gateways, store launch] tier: 2 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. store configuration / claiming trial links, entering payment details, selecting the Basic plan, activating Shopify Payments, verifying identity documents, connecting PayPal; product management / adding titles, writing descriptions using AI assistants, setting "compare-at" strikethrough prices, enabling inventory tracking, configuring physical package dimensions for shipping, adding variants, and adding product tags; collections / creating manual and automatic (smart) collections; shipping / defining domestic/international zones, setting free shipping thresholds (e.g., free over $75), configuring flat rates and carrier-calculated rates, adding handling buffers ($5); legal policies / utilizing Shopify templates for Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Shipping Policy, and Refund Policy; store launch / verifying domain propagation, executing test orders with test mode, and removing store password protection to take the site live.

The Test Order Protocol: Activating test mode inside payment settings to place a test order, confirming order confirmation emails arrive successfully, and then disabling test mode before public launch.
Checkout Marketing Opt-Ins: Enabling both email and SMS checkboxes at the checkout/sign-in page to capture direct marketing consent from buyers.
Password Removal (Launch): Navigating to Online Store > Preferences to disable the password protection toggle and push the store live to the public.
Skip. Promotional pitches for the Shopify $1 trial or generic motivational statements about starting a business.
Scope mix. 100% baseline (standard Shopify backend configuration). Volume. ~350 words.

07-LPG / landing pages Goes here. Selecting free Shopify themes (Dawn, Horizon, Trade), navigating the storefront editor, customizing sections (Hero/banner, Featured Collection, Testimonials, FAQ, AI-generated sections), adjusting global typography and color schemes, editing the header/footer (logo upload, favicon configuration, navigation menu structures, announcement bars), optimizing for mobile views, and building trust elements. Not here. • Adding the actual products, prices, and collections in the backend -> 05-SET

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the exact process for manipulating the visual front-end of a Shopify store using the native theme editor, highlighting theme selection, AI section generation, and global branding settings. modules: [LPG] topics: [theme selection, storefront editor, AI section generation, global styling, navigation menus] tier: 2 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. theme selection / choosing and publishing lightweight free themes (Dawn, Horizon, Trade); section customization / adjusting Hero banner images, setting heading tags to H1 for SEO, configuring button styles (Primary vs. Secondary), adding blurred reflections and fading transition effects, adding testimonial poll-quotes, utilizing AI-generated custom sections via prompts; global styling / uploading transparent PNG logos and square favicons, setting primary brand colors and high-contrast text, selecting simple readable fonts (Montserrat, Source Sans Pro); header and footer / positioning logos, setting announcement bars with urgency prompts (e.g., free shipping over $50), linking support and policy pages in the footer, toggling off "Powered by Shopify"; mobile optimization / reviewing layout spacing, button sizing, and touch-friendly navigation on mobile viewports.
The H1 SEO Rule: Ensuring the main homepage hero header is explicitly set to a Heading 1 (H1) tag to help search engines understand page structure.
Transparent PNG Logos: Using background removal tools (like remove.bg) to download transparent PNG logos before uploading them to the theme header to prevent messy white/colored box backgrounds.
Mobile Preview Audits: Switching to the mobile view in the theme editor to verify that text doesn't blend into images and that navigation remains thumb-friendly.
Skip. The prompt to "make it look good" or generic explanations of what a homepage is.
Scope mix. 100% baseline (visual storefront editing). Volume. ~300 words.
